s.es: muestra las bibliotecas dinámicas que necesita un ejecutable

tip.es: No uses ldd con binarios que no son de confianza: algunas versiones ejecutan el programa para obtener la lista.
tip.en: Do not use ldd on untrusted binaries: some versions run the program to get the list.

o.en: Print the version number of ldd.
Print all information, including, for example, symbol versioning information.
Perform relocations and report any missing objects (ELF only).
Perform relocations for both data objects and functions, and report any missing objects or functions (ELF only).
